title: Internal: Closing Personal Savings Accounts
summary: This document explains how to close Personal Savings Accounts, including pre-closure checks (OPEN status, no pending transactions, and sufficient balance if an early closure fee applies). It lists tier-based early closure fees ($20 Bronze/60 days, $35 Silver/Silver Plus/90 days, $75 Gold family/180 days, $150 Platinum/270 days) and required notice periods (1, 5, 10, 21 days), plus the need for manager approval for ELITE tier and the use of close_bank_account_7392.
faqs: What must be verified before closing a Personal Savings Account?
What is the early closure fee and notice period for an ENTRY (Bronze) account?
What are the early closure fee and notice period for MID tier (Silver and Silver Plus)?
What are the early closure fee and notice period for PREMIUM tier (Gold, Gold Plus, Gold Years)?
What are the early closure fee, notice period, and manager-approval requirement for ELITE tier accounts?
What steps and system action are required to close the account (including close_bank_account_7392)?
keywords: Early closure fee deduction from account balance
ENTRY TIER (Bronze Account) - $20 within 60 days - 1 days notice
MID TIER (Silver/Silver Plus) - $35 within 90 days - 5 days notice
PREMIUM TIER (Gold family) - $75 within 180 days - 10 days notice
ELITE TIER (Platinum/Platinum Plus/Diamond Elite) - $150 within 270 days - 21 days notice
